def fence(xs, ys, gap):
    n = len(xs)
    area2 = 0.0
    cost = 0.0
    gates = 0
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        area2 = area2 + xs[i] * ys[j] - xs[j] * ys[i]
        dx = abs(xs[j] - xs[i])
        dy = abs(ys[j] - ys[i])
        d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if dy > 2 * dx:
            rate = 19.0
        elif dx > 3 * dy:
            rate = 11.5
        else:
            rate = 14.0
        cost = cost + d * rate + (int(d // gap) + 1) * 8.0
        if d > 6 and gates < 2:
            gates = gates + 1
            cost = cost + 45.0
    area = abs(area2) / 2
    if area > 300:
        cost = cost - (300 - area) * 0.1
    return cost
